sections.notes: This river-and-reservoir trip requires two land portages: Park Mill (Third Marinette) and Menominee (First/Lower Marinette) dams. The 2017 FERC assessment documents both canoe carries, and the 2018 license requires their continued maintenance. Access markers show approximate facilities. The preliminary 8.6-mile river distance does not include walking or carry time.
sections.routeReview: Two dam portages are required. Check the signed take-outs, trails and downstream re-entry points during your shuttle, including whether your boat can be carried. Exact carry routes and shoreline connections are not drawn. Do not paddle through either dam; this access map is not a continuous floating route.

notices.title: Park Mill and Menominee dams: portage required
notices.text: FERC describes the Park Mill canoe carry on the north side of that dam, and the Menominee canoe carry on the Wisconsin side in Marinette. Both have steps. Inspect the signed exits, trails and re-entry points before launching, and stay outside restricted dam areas. The map does not mark the exact carry entrances or walking routes.
notices.sourceName: FERC — 2017 Menominee and Park Mill assessment, page 71

notices.title: Confirm portage conditions before your trip
notices.text: Article 409 of the 2018 project license requires maintenance of both canoe portages. This documents the facilities, not their condition today. Check with the operator and follow posted closures and signs; allow extra time for carrying your boat and gear.
